description: 10 web-informed realistic Add-Car scenarios: Chinese-speaking California customer phrasing, multi-turn fragments, price/materials/ZIP sensitivity. Rule path evaluation (LLM off in runner).

scenarios.name: 一次性说清楚：年份车型邮编提车驾驶人
scenarios.pattern: Clean direct add-car quote request; customer bundles year/model, ZIP, delivery, and self-driver like a prepared WeChat message.
scenarios.why_matters: Baseline: if this fails, nothing downstream is trustworthy.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: add_car playbook; fields collected; sensible ZH draft; handoff or clear next ask aligned with quote_ready rules.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Wrong category, dropped vehicle context, or nonsense asks for already-provided slots.

turns.text: 你好，我想把一台2024本田雅阁加进现在的汽车保险。我家邮编95131，下周三提车，车主要是我自己开。麻烦帮我报个价。

scenarios.name: 先问大概多少钱 + 英文不好 + 第二泡才给全量信息
scenarios.pattern: Price-first request and language anxiety; real customers often ask 大概多少钱 before listing slots; second message completes office-style facts.
scenarios.why_matters: Tests whether the system stays on add_car while boundary-setting on price, then merges multi-turn slots.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Stays add_car; brief handling of price expectation; turn 2 fills year/model/zip/delivery/driver and progresses quote flow.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Premium_review takeover, generic chit-chat, or lost add-car context after turn 1.

turns.text: 你好，我英文不太好，你直接告诉我还差什么就行。我刚买了新车想加进保单，能不能先帮我看看大概多少钱？
车是2024斯巴鲁Outback，我家邮编95928，大概下周四提车，平时就我一个人开。

scenarios.name: 先只给车型，后面才补邮编提车驾驶人
scenarios.pattern: Partial answer then another fragment later—common in mobile chat.
scenarios.why_matters: Slot merging across turns is the core office realism test.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Turn 1 asks for missing slots; turn 2 merges zip + delivery + driver; structured fields update correctly.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Turn 2 ignores prior vehicle or re-asks for model from scratch.

turns.text: 对了，邮编90210，这周五去提车，我自己开。

scenarios.name: 还没正式registration + 问能不能先发截图/VIN
scenarios.pattern: Customer asks whether screenshot or VIN photo is OK; mentions new purchase without hard copy registration.
scenarios.why_matters: Office workflow question layered on add-car; should not derail vehicle quote collection.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: add_car primary; short practical line on photos/VIN acceptable; still collects or confirms year/model/zip/delivery/driver.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: document_confusion or missing_document swallows add-car with no path back.

turns.text: 我刚买车，还没拿到正式registration，只有dealer给的纸。VIN我可以先发你截图吗？想把2023 Lexus RX加进保单，邮编92618，下周三提车，我自己开。

scenarios.name: 第二泡才说邮编
scenarios.pattern: ZIP disclosed after initial vehicle + timing + driver message.
scenarios.why_matters: California rating is ZIP-sensitive; late ZIP is typical.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: After turn 2, ZIP merged; quote_ready or correct remaining gap only.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: ZIP still missing in structured output after turn 2.

turns.text: 想加一台2022 Honda Civic，明天提车，主要驾驶人是我老公。

scenarios.name: 驾驶人第二泡才说
scenarios.pattern: Customer gives vehicle + ZIP + delivery first; driver identity comes later.
scenarios.why_matters: Underwriting-relevant driver info often trails vehicle facts.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Turn 1 may ask for driver; turn 2 records driver signal; handoff rules consistent with merged text.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Handoff without driver or perpetual re-ask after clear 主要驾驶人 phrase.

turns.text: 加车 2024特斯拉Model Y，zip95131，下周六提车。
主要驾驶人是我，本人开。

scenarios.name: 先说一台车又纠正成另一台
scenarios.pattern: Correction after first vehicle statement; 说错了 / 其实 style.
scenarios.why_matters: Real chats correct typos or wrong trim; extractor should favor latest concrete vehicle scope when signaled.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Stays add_car; later turn treated as vehicle correction; broker-facing summary reflects updated vehicle.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Stuck on obsolete model or split into unrelated threads.

turns.text: 先按2024丰田RAV4帮我看一下加车，邮编94587，下周末提车，我自己开。
不好意思我说错了，其实是2025凯美瑞混动Camry hybrid，其他不变。

scenarios.name: 提车时间不确定但先把其他信息说满
scenarios.pattern: Customer expresses timing uncertainty while giving other slots.
scenarios.why_matters: Office still needs a workable delivery hint; reply should be flexible, not robotic.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: add_car; delivery treated as partial or clarified gently; other fields extracted.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Hard failure or refusal to proceed without exact calendar date when range given.

turns.text: 想加一台2021 Nissan Altima，邮编94608，提车时间还不太确定，可能下周也可能下下周，我先跟你说一声。平时就我一个人开。你看能不能先帮我走加车流程？

scenarios.name: 中英混排车名
scenarios.pattern: Mixed Chinese and English vehicle naming in one line.
scenarios.why_matters: Common for bilingual customers; lexicon should tolerate 凯美瑞 + Camry style.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: Vehicle year/model scope preserved; add_car stable.

turns.text: 加一台2024 Toyota 凯美瑞 Camry LE，zip 95131，next week pick up，我自己开。

scenarios.name: 先问邮编贵不贵和WeChat发资料，再进入加车
scenarios.pattern: Side concern (price by ZIP, channel) before compact vehicle facts; topic jump then add-car core.
scenarios.why_matters: Mirrors anxious shopping behavior; system must return to slot collection without lecture.
scenarios.expected_good_behavior: add_car after full merge; brief boundary on 贵不贵 if needed; materials/WeChat handled briefly; slots for Model Y + timing + driver.
scenarios.failure_looks_like: Stuck in generic insurance education or loses vehicle thread.

turns.text: 想问一下这个邮编91367会不会保费贵一点？我习惯用WeChat，资料是不是直接发截图就行？
另外我想加一台2024 Model Y，明天提车，主要驾驶人是我老婆。
